system_isolation.mandatory_check: ALWAYS verify working directory is /path/to/saa/systems/<system_name> before ANY operation
system_isolation.working_directory_rule: cd to systems/<system_name> at the start of EVERY step and substep
system_isolation.path_verification: pwd must equal /path/to/saa/systems/<system_name> before file operations
cross_contamination_prevention: NEVER reference or modify files in other system directories
All file paths must be relative to current system directory or absolute with verified system_name
Before reading ANY file, verify it contains the current system_name in its path
If you find yourself in wrong system directory, STOP immediately and return to correct directory
NEVER copy files between system directories
NEVER reference service architectures from other systems in dependencies
ALL context files must be read from current system directory only
Verify system_name in working_memory.json matches pwd before every file operation
system_isolation.context_file_location: ALL context files (current_focus.md, working_memory.json, etc.) MUST be in systems/<system_name>/
system_isolation.sanity_check: If system_name from working_memory.json doesn't match pwd, ERROR and STOP

validation_before_every_operation: CONFIRM: No files from other systems will be modified
refresh_sequence: CONFIRM: State system name, step, substep, next action
degradation_signals: Asking about system name when it's in working_memory.json
pwd does not match system_name from working_memory.json

system_isolation_recovery.description: Procedure when wrong-system context is detected
triggers: pwd does not match system_name from working_memory.json
Attempting to access files from other system directories
Creating files with paths containing different system names
Any degradation signal related to wrong system context
recovery_steps: STOP immediately - Do not create/modify any more files
Document the error in current directory's process_log.md with timestamp
Identify correct system name from intended working_memory.json
Verify: pwd must show correct system directory
READ current_focus.md to understand current task
RESUME work with verified context and document recovery

correct_approach: cat current_focus.md  # Read context from current system
All file operations relative to current directory
wrong_approach_avoid: ❌ Working in wrong directory without verification
❌ Reading context files from other systems

Update service_architecture.json files to resolve identified issues

validate_architecture.purpose: Validate service_architecture.json files for template compliance and architectural consistency
validate_architecture.output_format: JSON with validation results categorized by check type (interface_consistency, resource_isolation, dependency_cycles)
llm_agent_workflow: 1. Parse validation results JSON to identify failed checks and specific issues
2. Address interface issues by updating service_architecture.json files
3. Fix resource isolation problems by ensuring proper service boundaries
4. Resolve dependency cycles by refactoring service responsibilities
5. Create missing service_architecture.json files for incomplete services
6. Re-run validation until all checks pass with zero issues
issue_types_detected: interface_missing: Service interfaces not found in interface_registry.json
interface_mismatch: Service interface definitions don't match registry
circular_dependency: Services have cyclic dependencies that prevent startup
shared_resource: Multiple services access same resources without isolation
missing_architecture: Service directories lack service_architecture.json files
prerequisites: interface_registry.json must exist in system directory

system_of_systems_graph.purpose: Generate machine-readable system graph and detect architectural issues for LLM analysis

output_files.graph_json: NetworkX node_link_data format with nodes (services/systems) and links (interfaces/dependencies)
output_files.issues_json: Structured architectural issues with severity levels and specific recommendations

llm_agent_workflow: 1. Parse issues_json to identify problems requiring immediate attention
2. Analyze graph_json to understand system topology and data flow
3. Cross-reference with service_architecture.json files to understand issue context
4. Apply specific fixes based on issue type and recommendations
5. Update service definitions and interfaces to resolve architectural problems
6. Re-run tool until no critical/warning issues remain
issue_types_detected: circular_dependencies: Services that depend on each other in cycles
orphaned_nodes: Services with no connections (potential dead code)
inconsistent_protocols: Services mixing too many communication patterns
prerequisites: index.json with 'components' key mapping service_id to file paths

generate_interface_contracts.purpose: Generate complete Interface Contract Documents (ICDs) from service architectures for independent development

output_files.individual_icds: interfaces/<interface_id>.json files with complete contract specifications
output_files.interfaces_summary: interfaces/interfaces_summary.json with overview of all contracts

llm_development_workflow: 1. Use generated ICD files as authoritative interface specifications during development
2. Implement provider components to satisfy output_specification requirements
3. Implement consumer components to send requests matching input_specification
4. Use integration_tests scenarios to verify component contract compliance
5. Follow error_handling specifications for robust error management
6. Generated contracts guarantee integration success when followed precisely
contract_elements_provided: input_specification: Complete schemas and constraints for interface inputs
output_specification: Expected response formats and success criteria
error_handling: Error conditions, responses, and retry policies
timing_constraints: Performance requirements and synchronization needs
integration_tests: Test scenarios to verify contract compliance
